intro: These words come from pages of Amerikanski Srbobran, a Serbian newspaper printed in Pittsburgh. The pages date from 1906 to 1963 and are held by the Library of Congress. The paper is printed in Cyrillic letters. Some Latin letters print the same as Cyrillic ones (C and С, P and Р), so they count as the same and are never highlighted.
name: Serbian
